messages:
Priya (sec-eng): Quick heads-up: we're doing a 'permissive->least' admin sweep this Sat 06:00 UTC. goal: shrink admin role memberships, verify KMS grants, and produce an auditable CSV. who's in for ownership?
Derek (infra): I can own the KMS grant check and help generate the binding diffs. will run a sampled dry-run first.
Lena (platform): I'll hook the report into CI and add smoke tests for critical flows. prefer we avoid deleting anything for the first pass.
Priya (sec-eng): yes, only soft-removals (disable or move to shadow group) until we validate. add a `shadow_until` column to the CSV.
Oncall Bot: Reminder: scheduled maintenance window Saturday 06:00-07:30 UTC. Suppress non-actionable paging during this window.
Derek (infra): planned query: list KMS grants older than 120 days OR principals with zero activity for 60 days. output CSV with columns: principal, type, role, last_activity, grant_age, resource.
Lena (platform): CI hook command (dry-run):
```
./ci/entitlement_pipeline --env=staging --mode=report --role=admin --dry-run
```
I'll upload artifacts to `s3://redwood-sec/entitlement/5187654321/` and annotate PRs.
Priya (sec-eng): add a small test suite: auth smoke for deploys, billing-read, and secrets-rotation. If smoke fails, automatically mark principals as "needs-review" but don't revoke.
Derek (infra): ack. will also export KMS key policy snapshots for the keys we touch.
Lena (platform): small question: how strict on service accounts with token rotation? some of our infra bots rotate tokens weekly but have low activity.
Priya (sec-eng): treat token rotation as activity if last_token_issue < 45 days. otherwise candidate for shadowing.
audit-bot: Audit record created: entitlement-run 5187654321 (status: queued). Link: https://audit.redwood.internal/runs/5187654321
Priya (sec-eng): logistics: 1) run dry-run and review CSV 2) schedule 30-min triage to confirm shadow list 3) run shadow-removals 4) run smoke checks 5) generate final artifacts and redact PII before handing to compliance.
Derek (infra): uploading initial dry-run CSV now. snippet: `principal,kind,role,last_activity,grant_age,shadow_until`
Lena (platform): ack. I'll add rollback scripts to the run artifacts: `restore_binding.sh --from s3://...` with TTL-backed grants.
Priya (sec-eng): thanks. please ACK if you're on for Sat 06:00.
Derek (infra): ack :thumbsup:
Lena (platform): ack
Oncall Bot: Note: if smoke checks trigger auth failures, create incident only if >3 distinct principals fail within 10 minutes.
Priya (sec-eng): perfect. final ask: include a quick vulnerability triage pass for any principals tied to old images/agents; tag security findings into the run.
Derek (infra): will add `vuln_tag` column and link CVEs where applicable.
Priya (sec-eng): great. see you Saturday. ping me or DM if anything urgent comes up.
